statuses.merged: On main, but not fully checked. See the to-do list.
statuses.notes: Tracked in the AI notes (ShimmyAI). Not part of these apps.

todo.item: Sign in to the Allowances site with a parent account. It uses the same login as the habits app. Check the balances match, then deposit and withdraw once.
Back up the old Allowances Supabase project (kbhlwannygavrnwbebtf), then pause or delete it. Its data is already copied and checked.
Decide on family_reflections. The habits app uses it, but the table doesn't exist, so weekly reflections stay on each device. Create the table, or tell Claude to remove the code that uses it.
The interest rate is still saved in each browser. Move it into the database so both parents share it.
Withdrawal requests can only be viewed. Add approve and decline buttons; the database function already exists.
In Supabase Auth settings, turn on leaked-password protection (currently off).
Supabase flags the games views (active_games_view, all_games_view) as running with their creator's permissions. Check whether that is intended.
The update_updated_at function has no fixed search path (Supabase advisor warning).
Register the Moment and StoryTime tables in the table index. You asked for this to wait.
After the Allowances check (T1), tell Claude to drop the temporary legacy_id columns on the allowance tables.
Confirm the scoring. Adding a task you haven't done yet still lowers the percentage. Say if you want that changed.
Check the member cards and scores on your phone or iPad. The tests ran in a desktop browser only.
Check the Allowances layout on an iPhone after the switch.
Run supabase/rewards_migration.sql in the Family project's SQL editor. Until it runs, the rewards section shows a setup note. It is safe to run more than once.

versions.summary: Offline construction-detail editor with exports to PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, DXF and JSON.

versions.title: Allowances data moved into the Family database
versions.summary: 13 transactions copied and checked against the old balances (Athena 6.25, Felix 5.50). Allowance tables added with sign-in-only access. Family Habits PR #1.

versions.title: Allowances retirement plan
versions.summary: Plan for freezing, copying, checking and archiving the old Allowances project. Allowances PR #1.

versions.title: Allowances app uses the Family database
versions.summary: The site reads kids from the family members list and writes to the allowance tables. Negative adjustments allowed; one interest payment per kid per month. Allowances PR #2. The sign-in has not been tested.

versions.title: Table index added
versions.summary: app_table_registry records which app uses which table, with a view that lists anything unclaimed. The convention is saved in the AI notes. ShimmyAI PR #4.

versions.title: Habits schema snapshot
versions.summary: Snapshot of the habit tables and their access rules, plus the data state (28 habits, 75 completions). Family Habits PR #2. Documentation only.

versions.title: Member card and scoring fixes
versions.summary: The first click on a member card now shows that member's habits. Scores count every completion, so bonuses can make up for shortfalls and the percentage can go above 100. Family Habits PR #3.

versions.title: Family rewards
versions.summary: Rewards are drafted and published from Settings, then pinned to the bottom of the home page with a progress bar. Each finished week a reward was met for is kept in a timeline, where it can be cashed in, corrected or voided. Allowance amounts are only suggestions. Database step: supabase/rewards_migration.sql (to-do T14).

versions.title: Bonus tickets
versions.summary: New Bonus (Stretch) task type with no target. Its completions are shown in their own section with a this-week count and an all-time count, and they never change the weekly target or percentage. Database check updated to allow the bonus type.

versions.title: Change log and to-do page
versions.summary: This page, opened from Settings. The to-do list shows what needs checking or chasing. Updated by hand when changes are merged.
